comment: Custody device development range. Real human input and server phases, no granted equipment or teleports. FRAGR_QA_BOTS=0, FRAGR_QA_MAP_FILE=server/maps/test/custody-range.json, FRAGR_QA_MANIFEST=res://qa/custody-range.json. Not a completed level 8.

states.name: custody_range_supplies
states.note: Claim the Rifle, Shotgun and Bullets through the normal supply path.

states.name: custody_cage_mines
states.note: Walk up the corridor and into the one-entrance alcove. The cage grants four counted mines; entering dispatches the post pair down the bent corridor.

states.name: custody_mine_arming
states.note: Press the ordinary mine key at the mouth. The strip records the throw, the stick on the corridor floor and the steady arming lamp.

states.name: custody_mine_live
states.note: Step back into the corner the corridor cannot see and watch the live blink until the post pair walks into the mine.

states.name: custody_mine_cleanup
states.note: Both named post Sweepers remain required, including anyone the actual blast reached.

states.name: custody_bay_approach
states.note: Enter the audit bay. The Auditor stands behind two Sweepers with its shield plate facing the entry.

states.name: custody_first_sweeper
states.note: Drop the nearer Sweeper first so the Auditor has a disabled body to reach.

states.name: custody_channel
states.note: The Auditor raises its hand and a channel reaches the disabled body. The strip records the beam and any stand-up before the repair.

states.name: custody_auditor_down
states.note: Break the channel and clear the bay, flanking the plate where the pillars allow.

states.name: custody_range_exit
states.note: Reach the final landmarks. This fixture has no campaign departure or save transition.
